name: Impotency
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (withered stalk of grain)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A male or female creature that fails their saving throw loses the ability to become interested or participate in sex. They additionally suffer a -2 penalty to all Charisma-based interactions with the opposite gender. This spell may be countered with remove curse.
